Stress The death of his father and pressure at work has placed significant stress on MG, potentially 
causing him to overeat, exercise less, and forget about the importance of his own health. MG could 
be educated on the benefits of meditation, yoga, and massage therapy as approaches to stress reduc­
tion and to help him re-gain perspective on what he values in life.
Preparation of Family Meals MG’s mother now lives with him and his family and cooks all their 
meals. As a result, he has less control over his diet, which may have contributed to the decline in 
his health. It is imperative that MG’s mother participates in the nutritional counseling sessions, as
